# road-kit todo demo: API reference for agents

<!-- GENERATED by road-kit scripts/generate-skill.mjs from contract/hello_world.gsc.json 0.1.0. -->

Contract 0.1.0. Use these with `road-cli api METHOD PATH [JSON]`. These are the
4 actions and 3 views the agent role may use.

## Actions

### Add a todo (`todos.create`)

`POST /todos/`. Propose a new todo for the caller. The owner is the caller; a request that names an owner is a wrong call.

Body: `title`, `notes`, `due_at`. Refused with: `TITLE_TAKEN`.

### Revise a todo (`todos.revise`)

`POST /todos/{id}/revisions/`. Propose a new title, notes or due time for an open todo. Completing and reopening have their own actions.

Body: `read_token`, `title`, `notes`, `due_at`. Refused with: `TODO_NOT_FOUND`, `STALE_TOKEN`, `TODO_DONE`.

### Complete a todo (`todos.complete`)

`POST /todos/{id}/completions/`. Propose marking an open todo done.

Body: `read_token`. Refused with: `TODO_NOT_FOUND`, `STALE_TOKEN`, `TODO_DONE`.

### Reopen a todo (`todos.reopen`)

`POST /todos/{id}/reopenings/`. Propose making a done todo open again.

Body: `read_token`. Refused with: `TODO_NOT_FOUND`, `STALE_TOKEN`, `TODO_NOT_DONE`.

## Views

### List todos (`todos.list`)

`GET /todos/`. The caller's todos, newest first, with the read token a later action on any of them must carry. Deleted todos are left out unless asked for. Another owner's todos need todo.list_all.

### Get a todo (`todos.get`)

`GET /todos/{id}/`. One todo as it is now, with the read token a later action on it must carry.

### Who am I (`session.me`)

`GET /session/me/`. The authenticated session: the caller, their roles and their effective permissions.
